GenAiPlugin.description: This topic provides essential information, FAQs, and best practices for agents. It acts as a centralized resource to quickly address common customer inquiries. Additionally, it greets customers in a friendly, conversational manner and introduces the assistant’s capabilities to guide the interaction effectively.
